QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_10

question.text: Fund started at NAV INR 1,000 per unit on 01-Jan-2022 and reached INR 1,728 per unit on 01-Jan-2025 (3 full years). What is the CAGR?

explanation.text: The Logic: CAGR = (Ending/Beginning)^(1/n) − 1 = (1728/1000)^(1/3) − 1 = 1.728^(1/3) − 1 = 1.20 − 1 = 20.00%. The Trap: 72.80% is cumulative absolute return. 24.27% is arithmetic avg of ~20%/year distorted. 19.63% is geometric mean of 1.2 with rounding. Cross-Exam Context: X-A Investment Adviser L1 tests CAGR at a conceptual level; XIX-E tests Cat III-specific usage for LP reporting. Manager's Pro-Tip: For Cat III open-ended with subscriptions/redemptions mid-period, CAGR on series NAV is misleading. Use TWR for fund performance and MWR for per-LP return.
